name: wds_food101
description: A webdataset-format variant of the Food-101 benchmark for image recognition, containing photos of 101 food classes. It measures visual classification performance on food images and is commonly used to train and evaluate image classification and representation-learning models, often under noisy web-collected conditions.
reputation: Well-known and widely used benchmark in computer vision for food recognition and representation learning, often used as a standard baseline.
